annotations.title: Deploy a version or a feature

description: Deploy (publish) a saved version so it goes live at its public address - the newest by default. With feature, deploy that feature's files to its own preview address instead, against its copy of the data, leaving the lambda alone. Returns diagnostics on failure, and whatever was online stays online.

feature.description: Deploy this feature to its preview address instead of a version to the lambda's.

name: deploy
